import itertools, json, sympy as s
from canonical_ground_parent_singlet_20261012 import wedge_action
# Exact noncommuting spectral derivative of exp(t A), t=log 2.
g=s.diag(1,1,-1,-1); A=wedge_action(g,2); b=s.zeros(4);b[0,2]=b[2,0]=s.Rational(1,2);B=wedge_action(b,2)
a=[A[i,i] for i in range(6)];F=s.diag(*[s.Integer(2)**x for x in a]);Z=s.trace(F**2)
dF=s.zeros(6)
for i in range(6):
 for j in range(6):
  if a[i]!=a[j]:dF[i,j]=B[i,j]*(F[i,i]-F[j,j])/(a[i]-a[j])
  elif B[i,j]!=0: raise AssertionError('control requires only unequal spectral blocks')
assert A*B!=B*A
assert s.trace(F*dF)==0
cost=s.simplify(s.trace(dF**2)/Z);cas=s.simplify(s.trace(F**2*B**2)/Z)
# log(2)>2/3; stronger rational check suffices for the stated logarithmic mean bound.
assert cost<s.Rational(4,9)*cas
assert s.simplify(s.trace(F**2)/Z)==1
# Canonical conditional variance, complete complement retained. Six good modes, two arbitrarily occupied bad modes.
lam=[-2,-1,0,0,1,2]; weights=[s.Rational(1),s.Rational(3,2),s.Rational(2),s.Rational(1),s.Rational(5,2),s.Rational(3)]
controls=[]
for n in [2,3,4]:
 terms=[(s.prod(weights[i] for i in S),sum(lam[i] for i in S),set(S)) for S in itertools.combinations(range(6),n)]
 z=sum(w for w,v,S in terms);m=sum(w*v for w,v,S in terms)/z;var=s.factor(sum(w*v*v for w,v,S in terms)/z-m*m)
 lower=s.Rational(1,384)*sum((lam[i]-lam[j])**2 for i,j in [(0,5),(1,4),(2,3)])
 assert var>=lower
 minp=min(sum(w for w,v,S in terms if i in S and j not in S)/z for i in range(6) for j in range(6) if i!=j)
 assert minp>=s.Rational(1,9)*s.Rational(n*(6-n),30)
 controls.append({'good_number':n,'variance':str(var),'matching_lower':str(lower),'ordered_pair_probability_min':str(minp)})
# A global linear normalization ceases to produce an extensive gain when a2 scales with volume.
V=s.symbols('V',positive=True);lin=-V/(1+V);assert s.limit(lin/V,V,s.oo)==0
print(json.dumps({'kind':'EXACT_CANONICAL_NORMALIZED_FILTER_METHOD_CONTROL_NOT_NATIVE_GROUND','spectral_derivative_cost':str(cost),'weighted_B2':str(cas),'rational_logmean_upper':'(4/9)*weighted_B2 < log(2)^2*weighted_B2','normalization_cross_zero':True,'noncommuting_blocks_retained':True,'all_canonical_complements':controls,'global_linear_extensive_gain_rejected':True,'native_ground_or_phase_computed':False},sort_keys=True))
